releases.body:
Put the wait in the header's tooltip, always drawn

The tooltip said the speed and the model, and the wait lived in the panel
alone, so one step read two ways depending on where you looked. The wait
is now the second of three lines, a dash when the step carries none and
red past ten seconds, and the panel keeps the line too.


Record: docs/oc-tps-meter.md
